Install through HACS as a custom repository, or copy `custom_components/lifepowr`
into your Home Assistant `config/custom_components/` directory.

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for what changed, and
[docs/api-notes.md](docs/api-notes.md) for how the FlexiO API actually behaves.

If your box runs different firmware, `python3 scripts/check_box.py` verifies the
field mapping against it and takes about a second.
